headline: Scientific Analog schedules an EQCHECK tutorial on AMS model equivalence
fact: Scientific Analog announced an upcoming DVCon Europe tutorial for November 17 on checking SystemVerilog analog/mixed-signal models against transistor-level circuits. The planned pipelined ADC example uses testbenches generated by EQCHECK and connects the checks with MODELZEN model extraction and XMODEL verification. The date is the scheduled tutorial date; the announcement was published October 30. As of November 15, this is a vendor-described tutorial plan, not a completed presentation, independently validated equivalence result or customer adoption.

sources.title: Meet Scientific Analog at DVCon Europe 2026
sources.summary: The October 30 official announcement schedules Automated Equivalence Checking for Analog/Mixed-Signal Models for November 17 and describes EQCHECK-generated testbenches, a pipelined ADC example and integration with MODELZEN/XMODEL. It does not name a presenter or establish completed results.
